title: Visual concept ranking uncovers medical shortcuts used by large multimodal models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing predictive performance of large multimodal models on skin lesion classification across different Fitzpatrick Skin Type (FST I/II vs. FST V/VI) subgroups using zero-shot and in-context learning prompts, and applying the Visual Concept Ranking (VCR) method to uncover differential reliance on visual shortcuts (e.g., surgical ink markings) between demographic groups.

Applying Visual Concept Ranking to identify model dependence on specific body part backgrounds (e.g., face, neck, scalp) and validating through manual intervention experiments that measure whether identical synthetic lesions receive different malignancy predictions when placed on different anatomical backgrounds.
